plugins.name: cavalry
plugins.description: Visual Stack by Cavalry Collective — a visual software planning and execution workflow for Claude Code. user-story-map — plan releases on an interactive drag-and-drop story map. wireframe — build a UI wireframe and comment directly on it in a review workspace. phase-wireframe — see a signed-off mockup at each release phase. init — start a project from the Cavalry template, choosing stack and add-ons on a visual chooser.
